epicDescription: A static-file, single-page site that loads under 2s on fast connections, renders cleanly on desktop (1024px+) and mobile (375px+), and maintains layout stability after initial paint.

features.title: Responsive Desktop
features.description: Desktop layout (1024px+) rendering cleanly with grid-based layout and full typography hierarchy. Desktop is where decisions get made.

views.title: Responsive Desktop Layout
views.description: Desktop-specific layout ensuring optimal rendering at 1024px and above

features.mvp_scope: Multi-column grid, proper padding, typography scale at desktop

features.title: Responsive Mobile
features.description: Mobile layout (375px+) rendering cleanly as a single column. Mobile-first browsing is the norm for initial discovery.

views.title: Responsive Mobile Layout
views.description: Mobile-specific layout ensuring optimal rendering at 375px and above

features.mvp_scope: Single-column stack, reduced padding, stacked card layout at 375px

features.title: Layout Stability
features.description: No layout shift after initial paint. Prevents CLS (Cumulative Layout Shift) to maintain trust and readability.

views.title: Layout Stability
views.description: Layout stability patterns ensuring no CLS after initial paint

features.mvp_scope: Aspect ratio containers for images, reserved space preventing layout shift

features.title: Static File Performance
features.description: Static-file delivery enabling sub-2s load time on fast connections. No server-side rendering needed.

views.title: Static File Performance
views.description: Static HTML/CSS with no external dependencies or CDN requirements

features.mvp_scope: Pure HTML/CSS, no JS, system fonts, lazy loading images
